description:
Today's recovery verdict: readiness status, the drivers behind it, and what it means for training.

        Deterministic synthesis of recent sleep, HRV, and training load —
        no new model calls. Status is one of "ready", "caution", "rest", or
        "unknown" ("unknown" when no recovery data exists — never treat missing
        data as a green signal). Coach tier only.
name: get_recovery_status
